prose: OpenAI said on Friday it is tightening limits on the weapons-related information ChatGPT provides to teens, even when a question appears harmless, as part of new safeguards, Reuters reports. The article is paywalled to the fetcher (HTTP 401), so only the announcement's framing is verifiable from the source.
highlights: OpenAI tightens weapons-related information limits for teens on ChatGPT
Applies even when a question appears harmless; part of new safeguards
basis: Techmeme summary of the Reuters report; Reuters returns HTTP 401 to the fetcher
